intuition.title: Reactive iodide delivery
intuition.summary: Rapid reactive iodide delivery favors fast precipitation with fewer slow-growth side products; slow5/60min addition andHIcooling yield the same main phase plus low-angle impurities.

intuition.title: Long-chain spacer packing
intuition.summary: Long alkyl chains may direct layered structure through interdigitation andvan-der-Waals interactions; C4/C6 mixtures versus C10/C12/C14 layered products support chain-length dependence, not a universal minimum-chain prediction.

intuition.title: Packing and optical behavior
intuition.summary: Spacer length changes packing/interlayer distance/phase transitions; optical edge and calculated frontier states depend mainly on inorganicAg/Bilayers.
